# U72: One way out of a form: each focus-mode page has one closing control with words (“Close and keep the draft” or “Close without saving”); closing a review’s set-up with something typed asks first, and Keep editing keeps it; Import’s check and its changes have one too, which goes back to Import

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `NAV-FORMS`
- **Budget:** at most 3 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `{addr}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 3745
